text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.80 to C$1.30 higher on shortcovering ahead of Monday's USDA crop production report and higher calls in CBOT soybean futures. July WCE futures canola crush profit margin ended at -3.08 on Thursday. Canada's dollar was weaker at C$1.3852 versus the U.S. dollar and fell to 88.00 yen and 1.2262 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.30 to C$0.80 up in the July with pressure expected in new crop contracts on overbought sentiments.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn, wheat calls.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.40 up in the July and C$0.20 down in December to reallign old crop-new crop spreads after commercials bought new crop at Thursday's close.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
